name: Haya Glutathione Skin Whitening Serum 30ml | Brightening, Anti-Aging & Dark Spot Remover
description:
Haya Glutathione Skin Whitening Serum by Rabi is a lightweight, fast-absorbing formula that helps brighten skin, fade dark spots, and reduce signs of aging. Enriched with Glutathione and potent antioxidants, it improves skin tone, smooths texture, and delivers deep hydration for a radiant, youthful glow. Suitable for all skin types, it is ideal for daily use to achieve visibly even and refreshed skin.
Key Features
 Brightens and whitens dull, uneven skin
 Fades dark spots, pigmentation, and acne scars
 Supports smooth and even skin tone
 Anti-aging protection with antioxidants
 Lightweight, fast-absorbing formula for daily use
 Suitable for all skin types
How to Use
 Apply 2–3 drops onto clean, dry skin
 Massage gently until fully absorbed
 Use morning and night for best results
 Follow with moisturizer or sunscreen as needed
Material
Glutathione, antioxidants, hydrating agents, serum base
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 30ml Haya Glutathione Skin Whitening Serum
